clips.alt: A rectangle drawn on the hinge mount's top face arrives with horizontal and vertical relations, two dimensions set it to 8 by 5 mm, and Fix on a corner leaves the sketch fully defined at 0 degrees of freedom.
The sketch on the hinge mount is extruded: the preview shows a 10 mm boss, the depth on the model is set to 4 mm, and the boss joins the part.
On the hinge mount, Fillet picks three edges at the back block's top front corner, the preview rounds them at 2 mm, the radius on the model is set to 3 mm, and the rounded edges join the part.
